summary: Data Storage Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into an Equity Distribution Agreement with Maxim Group LLC for at-the-market sales of common stock. The agreement allows the Company to sell shares from time to time through Maxim as agent, with a 2.5% commission on gross proceeds. No specific terms such as price, share amount, or valuation are stated; the filing is a routine capital markets activity comparable to a shelf takedown. The Company is not obligated to sell any shares under the agreement. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is present. This is a standard current report of a material definitive agreement for capital access.
